description: Prospective circuit-C LMP2 dataset. Bahrain was selected for high driver repeatability and clear long-straight/heavy-braking LICO opportunities. The first run is a push-only calibration collected before frozen LICO predictions.

runs.driver_notes: Five complete push laps recorded after outlap 15. Driver display labels are one greater at the finish line: display 19/20/21 map to DuckDB laps 18/19/20. Lap18 has a wide T15 exit; lap19 has a rear-tire slide and wide T4 exit; lap20 carries too much T15 apex speed and exits wide. Retain clean approach/braking signals and mask contaminated mid-corner/exit outcomes when zones are built.

lap_reviews.reason: Telemetry starts in the pits; this is the recorded outlap.
Wide final-corner exit. T15 approach and braking are usable; final-corner exit time is not a clean push reference.
Rear-tire slide and wide T4 exit. T4 approach and braking are usable; mid-corner and exit time are contaminated.
Excessive final-corner apex speed and wide exit. T15 approach and brake onset are usable; brake-release, apex and exit outcomes are contaminated.

runs.planned_lico_profile_description: Frozen static plan repeated on laps 24, 25, 27 and 28 within P/L/L/P/L/L/P; zone action distances vary by push braking geometry.
runs.driver_notes: Driver reported no notable driving error, appropriate zone identification and generally good lift points. T10 felt too strong, with an estimated 0.3-0.4 s local loss; very light LICO may remain plausible. Native LastImpactMagnitude toggled near 750 m on lap29, but the driver reported no notable incident and the lap was the fastest of the block, so it is retained with a review tag rather than excluded.
